title: Feasibility Trial of Family-Centered Therapeutic Dance for Children With Disabilities
official: Exploratory Cluster-Randomized Feasibility Trial of a School-Based, Family-Centered Therapeutic Dance Intervention for Children With Disabilities
summary:
The primary aim of this exploratory cluster-randomized trial is to assess the feasibility and acceptability of delivering a school-based group therapeutic dance program through a family-centered approach for children with disabilities and to generate preliminary estimates of intervention effects and outcome variability to inform the design of a future definitive cluster-randomized controlled trial.

No confirmatory effectiveness hypothesis is prespecified for this exploratory trial. Instead, the study will estimate the direction, magnitude, and precision of pre-liminary between-group differences in the primary and secondary clinical outcomes and will characterize feasibility and implementation parameters relevant to a future definitive trial.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* children with motor impairment
* aged between 3-14 years
* who can cognitively follow simple tasks

Exclusion Criteria:

* having suffered a serious clinical condition or surgical intervention in the last 6 months.
